revision: SRDA05 protection review for FCPLCn DATA8, 2026-11-14
scope: Five SRDA05-4BTG arrays replace eight PESD packages; ten100R resistors only on FIELD side. Lower15VTVS andRS485SM712 unchanged. Upper148/Lower154/combined302.

pin_topology.REF1_connection: Unique floating local node per array; no power rail, local ground or other array connection. This standalone internal-TVS arrangement is inferred from the manufacturer functional diagram.
pin_topology.REF2_connection: Both pins directly to local ground, short low-inductance copper. D1/D4 MAIN; D2/D3/D6 FIELD.
pin_topology.unused_IO: D1pins6/7 toGND; D3pins6/7 toGND_ISO. Inference from steering diode polarity: does not short positiveREF1 toground. No separate manufacturer unused-pin textual recommendation found.
pin_topology.series_location: Connector/TVS node ->100R->ISO side2. Existing4.7k pullup remains onISO side of resistor. CPUside unchanged.
pin_topology.USB: D+/- connector ->D1 shunt ->existingR11/R12 22R->CPU. No extra100R or shunt capacitor.
pin_topology.LED: D4 shunts connector-side LED outputs; existing470R/PNP remain. PWR470R andother IC paths still can inject residual current into a supply; floatingREF1 does not eliminate every injection path.

normal_logic_conditions: The .4V externalLOW assumption requires the selected sensor to sink the calculated current. DS18B20 specifies at least4mA at.4V.
External additional pullups, if fitted, must have equivalent resistance>=2.2k5%; do not parallel arbitrarily many sensor-board pullups.
Use3-wire externally powered standard-speed1-Wire; parasite power andoverdrive are not qualified. DHT22-like protocol timing must be tested with implemented driver.
Initial isolatedI2C100kHz andeach external line total capacitance<=200pF. This includes sensor/cable/PCB/TVS/isolator and must be measured; SRDA8pF is typical only.
CPUside LOW budget remains only53.125mV at the25C static rail estimate; no added CPUseriesR. Supply ripple/temperature remain separate prototype constraints.

leakage_and_power.note: The suballocations are engineering reserves inside existing70mA MAIN and55mA FIELD electronics allocations.16x10uA and8pF CVf are illustrative at stated characterization conditions, not guaranteed temperature/5.5V corner bounds. Verify actual leakage/current at maximum TMR voltage andtemperature.

prototype_release_limits: SRDA typical line-ground clamp9.2V@1A and21V@25A exceeds normalISO input absolute limitVCC+0.5V.100R limits current but cannot establish absolute-maximum compliance; input-output current rating is not permission for ESD injection.
Need powered/unpowered ESD atDATA/I2C/USB/LED connectors, actualIC pin voltage/current andrail overshoot measurements. Component IEC rating is not board certification.
USB12Mbps functional andsignal-quality validation required.22R*8pF RC is only an incremental first-order illustration; no guarantee from8pFtyp withoutmaximum.
No sustained12V/24V miswiring protection. No poweredUpper mating/unmating.

Vishay CRCW0805100RFKTAHP is a pulse-proof0805,1%,0.5W family part; current09-Jun-2026 document identifieslead-bearing construction. NoRoHS claim. Pulse selection does not qualify wholeboard transient behavior.

USB_channel_assignment.reason: Explicitly approved swap of electrically symmetric SRDA IO1/IO2 for local routing; connector and CPU USB polarity unchanged.
